elements.element: Vendor must maintain commercial general liability insurance.
elements.evidence: Section 16.7(a) requires Array to maintain commercial general liability insurance.

elements.element: Commercial general liability insurance must have a limit of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: Section 16.7(a) specifies not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.

elements.element: Commercial general liability insurance must have an aggregate limit of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 16.7(a) specifies not less than USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain professional errors and omissions insurance.
elements.evidence: The clause requires product liability and clinical trial liability insurance, not professional errors and omissions insurance.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions insurance must have a limit of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: No professional errors and omissions coverage or corresponding limit is stated. The USD 2,000,000 product liability limit is not an E&O limit.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, Vendor must maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance.
elements.evidence: Section 16.7(c) applies only where Array processes Ono Confidential Information or personal data. That trigger does not demonstrably cover all Customer Data, which may include data that is neither confidential nor personal.

elements.element: Cyber and privacy liability insurance required for processing Customer Data must have a limit of at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: Although the stated cyber/privacy limit is USD 5,000,000, it applies only under the narrower Confidential Information or personal-data trigger and therefore does not guarantee that limit whenever Array processes Customer Data.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.
elements.evidence: Section 16.7(d) requires workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable Law.

elements.element: Vendor must provide certificates of insurance upon Customer's request.
elements.evidence: Array must provide Ono with certificates evidencing the coverage upon Ono's request.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain professional errors and omissions insurance.
elements.evidence: The clause contains product liability and clinical trial liability insurance but no professional errors and omissions insurance.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions insurance must have a limit of at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: No E&O coverage or E&O limit is included; the product liability limit cannot satisfy this requirement.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, Vendor must maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance.
elements.evidence: The operative trigger is processing Ono Confidential Information or personal data, which is not demonstrably coextensive with processing Customer Data.

elements.element: Cyber and privacy liability insurance required for processing Customer Data must have a limit of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The stated USD 5,000,000 limit exceeds the fallback amount but is subject to a narrower trigger, so coverage at that amount is not required for every instance of processing Customer Data.

result.reason: Neither level is satisfied because the redline substitutes product/clinical-trial liability insurance for the required professional E&O coverage. Its cyber trigger also covers only Ono Confidential Information or personal data, not demonstrably all Customer Data. The redline is not minimal because it fails both complete positions while adding product liability coverage, employer's liability, a one-year post-term period, cancellation/change notice, reputable-insurer language, and a self-insurance alternative. The original indemnity and recall language remains unchanged, so unrelated commercial terms are preserved.
